newsitem.title: CHINA: China Southern shrs debut at HK$5.00 ea.
newsitem.headline: China Southern shrs debut at HK$5.00 ea.

text.p: Shares of China Southern Airlines Co Ltd made their trading debut at HK$5.00 per share compared with their issue price of HK$4.70 each.
The shares edged down to HK$4.80 each after ten minutes of trade.
China Southern offered 1.03 billion H-shares in a global flotation last week, of which the 71 million shares offered to the Hong Kong public was 2.44 times subscribed.
H-shares are stocks of Chinese-incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.
In addition to the Hong Kong offering, 353.51 million shares were sold in the United States and the balance was offered in an international placement and to strategic investors.

China Southern operates 270 routes serving 68 destinations in China. It said it would use the net proceeds of the offering to buy new aircraft, repay debt, and install and expand flight operation systems and facilities.
